purpose: Provide a scheduler-independent trigger path for private-repository Shine Defence attestation workflows while preserving repo-bound GitHub Actions OIDC as the sole source of trusted release-head and rollback-source evidence.

githubAuthentication.installationTokenRepositoryScope: only repositories in the current dispatch plan

sequencing: If authority heartbeat is not current or is inside the refresh margin, dispatch only the Core authority-state workflow.
Do not dispatch target repository workflows in the same cycle as an authority refresh.
On a later Supabase cycle, target workflows may be dispatched only after authority state is current.
A dispatched workflow must still pass its existing repo-bound OIDC and live authority verification before Foundation records any trusted evidence.
invariants: The dispatcher cannot mint release-head evidence.
The dispatcher cannot mint rollback-source proof.
The dispatcher cannot extend rollback proof TTL.
The dispatcher cannot mint or rewrite attestation authority state.
The dispatcher cannot bypass GitHub Actions OIDC verification.
The dispatcher cannot bypass live authority heartbeat verification.
GitHub App tokens and JWTs are never persisted in Postgres.
Missing GitHub App credentials produce a recorded disabled heartbeat and zero GitHub mutations.
The public Edge Function entrypoint requires a single-use short-lived database lease and accepts no reusable inbound secret.
Browser roles receive no database access to leases, events, heartbeats or recorder functions.
